visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a young woman with long black hair, fair skin, and crescent moon earrings smiling at the camera. She is wearing a white knitted top. Her makeup is clean with a pinkish tone. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a SUQQU eyeshadow palette with four shimmering shades: dusty rose, sparkling pink, brownish-taupe, and a pale cream. A makeup brush rests inside the case. (3) Transitions to a gradient blush palette showing a transition from deep pink to a light peach color with a swirling pattern embossed on the surface. A small application brush is shown at the bottom of the compact. (4) A top-down view shows four lipstick tubes lined up, followed by a shot of an arm with five different shades of red and pink lipstick swatched on the skin, each labeled with a number. (5) The woman is shown in various close-up shots applying different lipstick shades to her lips using the gold-cased tubes. She smiles and poses after each application, showing the final lip color. (6) She demonstrates applying eyeshadow from palette #14 onto her eyelids using a small brush. The camera zooms in on her eyes to show the blending and shimmer effect. (7) She uses a large fluffy brush to apply the gradient blush to her cheeks, blending it upwards towards her temples. (8) The video concludes with the woman holding the products and smiling, showcasing the completed 'Hanafubuki' spring makeup look against a plain, bright white background.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long dark hair, wearing crescent moon earrings and a white textured knit sweater.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM at approximately 105 BPM. A female voice with a friendly, high-clarity tone introduces the SUQQU spring makeup collection. (2) As the speaker transitions to describing the eyeshadow palette, a subtle 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes the visual cut. The BGM remains steady with a light rhythmic beat. (3) During the demonstration of lipstick swatches, the vocal intensity slightly increases to convey excitement. Short 'pop' or 'ding' sound effects coincide with labels appearing on screen. (4) In the tutorial section for eyeshadow application, the voice maintains a consistent pace, acting as an instructional guide. The background music ducking is professionally handled to ensure speech takes precedence. (5) The video closes with the narrator encouraging viewers to visit counters, with the BGM swelling slightly in volume during the final logo animation before a clean fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Product Showcase -> Application Tutorial -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote SUQQU's 'Hanafubuki' (Flower Screen) spring makeup collection. It combines aesthetic product close-ups with a practical application tutorial to demonstrate the versatility and high quality of the cosmetics, targeting beauty enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcase of a specific brand's new collection with product numbers and call-to-action to visit counters.
